{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bothan Colonial Board''' was the governing body of a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan Space/Legends|colony]] [[planet/Legends|world]], such as [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. 
==Kothlis colonial board==
One of the first actions of the Board, was petitioning the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactc Republic]] for the installation of a hidden [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. The Republic agreed and funded it.<ref name="guide" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the colony of Kothlis was governed by a board overseen by local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]]. It consisted of 12 Bothan consuls, all belonging to each of the three founding clans, [[clan Balya]], [[clan Alya]] and [[clan Ilya]]. Each consul served a 2,500 [[local day/Legends|day]] term.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Nine of the consuls were responsible for a particular facet of society (businesses, [[Consul of Natural Resources|natural resources]], labor, import/export, economy, arts and others), and chose and oversaw directors and subdirectors under them; these were picked on the principles of political favoritism. Each of the other three consuls was representing the interests of the three founding clans. The consul-general was in charge of defense and law enforcement.<ref name="guide" />

Elections meant little for the Board on Kothlis; although it was customary to spend a lot for campaigning and petitioning, consuls were almost always re-elected, unless for loss of favor. Replacing an existing consul meant that they would pick up their own directors, according to their political maneuvering and favors.<ref name="guide" />

The consul-general had the authority to overturn board's decisions, but [[Gilad Halsek]] rarely made use of it; he also abstained from the votes, unless he needed to break a tie.<ref name="guide" />
